supplements.title: The role of prehabilitation in improving brain health and cognition after chemotherapy in patients with colorectal cancer: Study protocol of the Chemo Brain Prehab Project.
supplements.summary: Researchers are testing whether exercise and training before chemotherapy can prevent memory and thinking problems in colorectal cancer patients.

supplements.title: Evaluation of the anticancer effects of ellagic acid and cisplatin in cisplatin-sensitive and -resistant MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Ellagic acid combined with cisplatin effectively kills breast cancer cells by reducing drug resistance and triggering cell death mechanisms.

supplements.title: UHRF1 as an epigenetic therapeutic target in Cancer.
supplements.summary: UHRF1 protein, overexpressed in many cancers, is a promising drug target that could be inhibited to stop tumor growth and restore treatment sensitivity.

supplements.title: Herbacetin alleviates acute doxorubicin cardiotoxicity via regulating the ERK1/2-FOXO3a signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Herbacetin protects heart cells from doxorubicin chemotherapy damage by activating a specific cellular signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Vitamin D inhibits the development of colorectal cancer cells by regulating the gut microbiota and immune microenvironment using JAKSTAT signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Vitamin D reduces colorectal cancer cell growth by improving gut bacteria and immune response through a specific signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Examination of the Effect of Riboflavin on TNF-α, Cas-3 Expression and SIRT1/p53/Bax/Bcl-2 Gene Expression in Diatrizoate-Induced Experimental Nephropathy Model.
supplements.summary: Riboflavin reduced inflammation and cell death markers in a kidney damage model by activating protective genes.

supplements.title: Efficacy of a plant-based diet on FOLFOX chemotherapy-induced gastrointestinal toxicity in patients with colorectal cancer: study protocol for a multicentre, stratified, randomised controlled trial.
supplements.summary: A study will test whether a plant-based diet reduces stomach problems in colorectal cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy.

supplements.title: Longitudinal Plasma Metabolomics Guides Dynamic Risk Assessment and Dietary Modulation for Esophageal Squamous Cell Cancer Chemoimmunotherapy.
supplements.summary: Blood metabolite patterns predict esophageal cancer treatment response and specific dietary compounds improve immunotherapy outcomes.

supplements.title: Effects and mechanisms of probiotics supplement on hypertension.
supplements.summary: Probiotics may help lower blood pressure by improving gut health, offering a potential side-effect-free treatment for hypertension.

supplements.title: Discovery of natural apigenin analogues as lysine-specific demethylase 1 inhibitors against tumoral testicular germ cells.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified a natural apigenin compound that inhibits LSD1 protein and effectively stops testicular germ cell tumor growth in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: Three novel benzophenones from Mesua caudata (King) Kosterm. and their cytotoxic activity.
supplements.summary: Researchers isolated three new compounds from a plant that killed cervical and breast cancer cells in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: De novo synthesis of plant polyketide plumbagin in yeast: a platform for sustainable production of naphthoquinones.
supplements.summary: Scientists engineered yeast to produce plumbagin, a plant compound with anti-cancer potential, enabling sustainable large-scale manufacturing.

supplements.title: S-equol producing bacteria: isolation and identification from Albino Wistar rat gut microbiota.
supplements.summary: Researchers isolated gut bacteria from rats that produce S-equol from soy, a compound potentially protective against hormone-related cancers.

supplements.title: Breviscapine inhibits the proliferation and immune escape of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma cells by regulating JAK2/STAT3/PD-L1 pathway.
supplements.summary: Breviscapine, a natural compound, stops diffuse large B-cell lymphoma cells from growing and hiding from the immune system.

supplements.title: α-Ketoglutarate protects against cartilage damage via epigenetically driven metabolic reprogramming in osteoarthritis models.
supplements.summary: Alpha-ketoglutarate supplements protect cartilage from osteoarthritis damage by restoring metabolic function through epigenetic changes.

off_label.title: Cardioprotective effects of prophylactic ACE inhibitors in anthracycline-induced cardiotoxicity: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized trials.
off_label.summary: ACE inhibitors help prevent heart damage in cancer patients receiving anthracycline chemotherapy, particularly those also taking trastuzumab.

off_label.title: Targeting the RXR Pathway for the Prevention of Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
off_label.summary: RXR agonist drugs delayed or prevented triple-negative breast cancer development in mouse models with minimal side effects.

off_label.title: The multifunctional RNA helicase DDX39A drives glioblastoma progression by modulating WISP1 alternative splicing that induces an immunosuppressive macrophage polarization.
off_label.summary: DDX39A protein drives glioblastoma growth by suppressing immune cells; blocking it with a drug slows tumor progression.

off_label.title: Androgen Receptor Drives Polyamine Synthesis, Creating a Vulnerability for Prostate Cancer.
off_label.summary: High-dose androgen therapy for prostate cancer boosts polyamine production, which can be blocked with a drug to improve treatment effectiveness.

off_label.title: T2R5 Agonist Phendione Decreases Cell Viability and Induces Apoptosis in Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
off_label.summary: A compound called phendione kills head and neck cancer cells by activating a taste receptor, offering a new treatment approach.

off_label.title: Regulation of Autophagy and Metabolism in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: Involvement of Wnt-β-Catenin Pathway.
off_label.summary: Riluzole stops hepatocellular carcinoma growth by blocking a key pathway that controls cancer cell metabolism and triggers cell death.

off_label.title: Phase 2 Study of Systemic IL-6 Receptor Antagonist ACTEMRA® (Tocilizumab) for the Treatment of Progressive/Recurrent Pediatric Adamantinomatous Craniopharyngioma
off_label.summary: A drug that blocks IL-6 is being tested to treat children with recurrent brain tumors called craniopharyngioma.

off_label.title: A Phase IIa, Placebo-Controlled, Randomized Study of Daily Obeticholic Acid (OCA) to Reduce Intestinal Polyp Burden in Familial Adenomatous Polyposis (FAP)
off_label.summary: A study tested whether obeticholic acid reduces intestinal polyp burden in familial adenomatous polyposis patients.

off_label.title: ASO Visual Abstract: Evaluation of Talimogene Laherparepvec for the Treatment of Advanced Nonmelanoma Skin Cancers.
off_label.summary: T-VEC, an oncolytic virus therapy, produced durable responses in over half of advanced nonmelanoma skin cancer patients, especially when combined with immunotherapy.

off_label.title: Repurposing statins for choriocarcinoma: targeting the mevalonate pathway to disrupt mechanosignaling and overcome therapeutic resistance.
off_label.summary: Statins may help treat aggressive choriocarcinoma by blocking a cellular pathway that drives tumor invasion and drug resistance.

off_label.title: GLP-1s Spur Greater Reduction in Colorectal Cancer Risk than Aspirin.
off_label.summary: GLP-1 drugs reduce colorectal cancer risk by 36% more effectively than aspirin in large populations.

off_label.title: Nutrient Availability Dictates Cancer Metabolism-Based Therapeutic Responses to Nononcology Drugs.
off_label.summary: A screening platform identifies non-cancer drugs that kill cancer cells more effectively when nutrient availability is restricted, enabling personalized treatment.

off_label.title: Metformin as an immunometabolic modulator in breast cancer: integrating NK and NKT cell responses.
off_label.summary: Metformin boosts immune cells to fight breast cancer by reprogramming tumor metabolism and restoring natural killer cell function.

off_label.title: PLOD2 Promotes Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma Progression in Association With STAT3-Related ERK and AKT Pathways.
off_label.summary: PLOD2 protein drives skin cancer growth through STAT3 signaling, and blocking it with minoxidil slows tumor development.

off_label.title: Retinal Astrocytic Hamartoma in a Child With Neurofibromatosis Type 1 Treated With Selumetinib.
off_label.summary: Selumetinib, a drug used to treat neurofibromatosis tumors, unexpectedly shrank a rare eye tumor and restored vision in a child.

biomarkers.title: Neoadjuvant Systemic Therapy in Kidney and Bladder Cancer: Current Evidence and Emerging Paradigms.
biomarkers.summary: Neoadjuvant therapy before surgery improves outcomes in kidney and bladder cancer, with immunotherapy showing promise alongside chemotherapy.

biomarkers.title: Primary Clear Cell Adenocarcinoma of the Female Urethra: A Case Report of a Rare Disease.
biomarkers.summary: Doctors report imaging findings for a rare female urethral cancer, emphasizing MRI and PET/CT's role in diagnosis.

biomarkers.title: Brain and Spinal Leptomeningeal Metastases in Prostate Cancer Detected by PSMA PET and MRI Fusion.
biomarkers.summary: PSMA PET imaging successfully detected widespread brain and spinal cord metastases in a prostate cancer patient with worsening neurological symptoms.

biomarkers.title: Dynamic reprogramming of the tumor immune network via multicycle checkpoint degradation for cancer immunotherapy.
biomarkers.summary: A new platform called RECYC removes immune checkpoint proteins from multiple immune cells in tumors, enhancing anti-tumor immunity better than current treatments.

biomarkers.title: Structural and mechanistic basis of mTORC2 activation of protein kinase AKT/PKB.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified how mTORC2 specifically activates AKT protein, enabling development of targeted cancer therapies blocking this crucial growth pathway.

biomarkers.title: Streamlined Digital Microfluidics-Mass Spectrometry Strategy for Extracellular Vesicle Enrichment and Lipid Profiling.
biomarkers.summary: A new microfluidic device rapidly isolates and analyzes lipids in cancer cell-derived vesicles, revealing immune-related lipid differences in minutes.

biomarkers.title: [Pediatric parasagittal meningioma, case report].
biomarkers.summary: Pediatric meningiomas are rare brain tumors often misdiagnosed as migraines or other common conditions, delaying treatment.

biomarkers.title: Feline Cancers: Cat-aloging the Mutational Landscape.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers sequenced cat tumors and found mutations similar to human cancers, particularly in the TP53 gene, supporting cats as cancer research models.

biomarkers.title: Glucose metabolism sustains aberrant STAT3 signaling in colorectal cancer through glycosylated local signaling factors.
biomarkers.summary: Glucose metabolism keeps STAT3 abnormally active in colorectal cancer, offering a new target for treatment.

biomarkers.title: Investigation of Radiolabeled KISS1R Ligands as Promising Tools for Diagnosis and Treatment of Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed improved radiolabeled peptides targeting KISS1R receptor to diagnose and treat triple-negative breast cancer more effectively.

biomarkers.title: Integrated CTC Enrichment and Dual-Responsive Nanoprobe Identification Enable Intelligent Liquid Biopsy-Based Cancer Diagnosis.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a new blood test using nanoparticles to identify lung cancer cells circulating in blood more accurately than existing methods.

biomarkers.title: Characterization of Kidney and Liver Cystic Phenotype Associated with GANAB Using Advanced Imaging Biomarkers.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers used advanced imaging to better understand how GANAB gene mutations cause cysts in kidneys and livers.

biomarkers.title: Apoptotic Marker Analysis in Heated-Intraperitoneal Chemotherapy Effluent Fluid Is Associated With Prognosis in Patients With Peritoneal Metastases.
biomarkers.summary: A blood test measuring cell death markers in chemotherapy fluid predicts survival outcomes for patients with abdominal cancer spread.

biomarkers.title: Hybrid Community-EHR Approaches to APOL1 Kidney Disease Screening and Clinical Trials among Black Individuals.
biomarkers.summary: A study used community education and screening to identify Black patients with genetic kidney disease for a clinical trial testing a new treatment.

biomarkers.title: Real-World Use of Dostarlimab Plus Chemotherapy in Advanced or Recurrent dMMR Endometrial Cancer: A Nationwide Cohort Study in France.
biomarkers.summary: French study confirms dostarlimab combined with chemotherapy improves outcomes for advanced endometrial cancer with specific genetic markers.

trials.title: Phase I multi-center clinical and biomarker study of the dual-action androgen receptor inhibitor ONCT-534.
trials.summary: ONCT-534, a new prostate cancer drug, safely reduced androgen receptor protein levels but showed limited clinical benefit in early testing.

trials.title: SPAG5 promotes ferroptosis and enhances chemotherapy efficacy in locally advanced colorectal cancer via upregulating intracellular ROS levels.
trials.summary: SPAG5 protein boosts colorectal cancer chemotherapy effectiveness by increasing cell-damaging reactive oxygen species levels.

trials.title: Multimodal imaging evaluation and management of orbital metastasis: experience at a single institution.
trials.summary: Researchers studied imaging scans to better identify and treat rare cancers that spread to the eye socket.

trials.title: M2pep-modified liposomal nanoparticles delivering siITGB4 induce apoptosis and inhibit NSCLC metastasis via macrophage reprogramming.
trials.summary: Modified nanoparticles targeting lung cancer macrophages reprogram immune cells and reduce tumor spread and growth.

trials.title: Clinical and immunological implications of lymphocyte-activation gene 3 expression in metastatic colorectal cancer.
trials.summary: LAG3 expression in metastatic colorectal cancer affects prognosis and immune response, suggesting it as a potential treatment target.

trials.title: Clinical outcomes of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma with pathological complete response after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy and surgery.
trials.summary: Esophageal cancer patients who achieve complete tumor elimination after pre-surgery chemotherapy and radiation show improved outcomes.
